title: Owner test of a floating bubble over Royal Enfield navigation

publisher.name: Owner report from the active MirrorDash development conversation

version.label: Owner-provided Android phone and Himalayan 450 Tripper; app versions and firmware not recorded for this observation

access.notes: The owner reports that Royal Enfield navigation was connected to the TFT, a WhatsApp floating bubble was opened above the active app, and the TFT navigation remained visible. The owner did not report tapping a display-off control in this test. The duration and whether Android was locked were not specified.

confidence.rationale: Direct owner observation supports that the tested WhatsApp bubble did not interrupt navigation in that run; it does not validate MirrorDash's overlay implementation or Shizuku display-off command.

claims.claim: In the owner's test, a WhatsApp floating bubble appeared over active Royal Enfield navigation while the TFT route remained visible.
claims.location: Owner report in the conversation on 2026-11-08.
limitations: The TFT image was owner-observed, not independently captured.
This was a WhatsApp bubble, not the new MirrorDash bubble.
The test did not turn off the display or verify locked-phone continuity.
